more_info.overview: Lignosulphonates are lignin-derived polymer preparations obtained during sulphite pulping of plant material. EFSA evaluated calcium, sodium and magnesium preparations together for a feed-binder application. Their binding function helps hold feed ingredients together. The mixture of large lignin-derived molecules distinguishes them from a single purified chemical. These feed uses do not establish permission for direct addition of every lignosulphonate to human food.
more_info.origin: Plant-derived lignin material chemically converted during sulphite pulping. The assessed preparations are lignosulphonate salts containing calcium, sodium or magnesium.
more_info.precautions: EFSA identified inhalation of dust from the evaluated feed preparation as a hazard for handlers in its 2015 assessment. This occupational finding does not describe an adverse effect from eating food made from treated animals.
more_info.banned_in: EFSA identified an inhalation hazard for handlers of the evaluated feed preparation in 2015.
